snippet.title: Hauntingly Beautiful Horror Game | Play With or Without Entities | Greenhouse
snippet.description:
Step into the hauntingly beautiful world of Greenhouse, a stunning new liminal horror game that blends unsettling atmosphere with eerie botanical spaces. 🌿

👀 A psychological horror experience you can play with or without entities.

🎮 Play Demo and Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3207210/Greenhouse
